pages.title: Lantern Fox
text: A bonded Lantern Fox lights the way.
An invisible **Spirit Light** travels with it at light **10**; the Glow-vein mark raises that to **12**.
You have Night Vision while you stay within **8 blocks** of it.
Every **4 seconds** it marks ores within **6 blocks** of itself with glints only you can see. Keen shortens that wait, a strong Hum quickens it, and Night Hum quickens it again after dark.
pages.title: The fox's lantern
Mossback
text: A bonded Mossback carries your things.
Sneak-use it with an **empty hand** to open a **9-slot** saddlebag, or **12** with Deep Pocket.
If it dies, the bag spills on the ground.
pages.title: The Mossback's saddlebag
Dawn Stag
text: A bonded Dawn Stag can be ridden without a saddle.
Use it to climb on. Steer with your gaze, hold jump for a short leap and sneak to dismount. It carries only the one it is bonded to.
Stride makes it faster; the Leap mark jumps higher.
pages.title: Riding the stag

text: They strike whoever struck you, and whoever you strike, but never a player or another keeper's companion. A wild remnant they strike will fight back. They are brave, not unbeatable: they still lose to the guardians.
**Soft Maw** keeps them from biting villagers or golems. **Track** (two copies, hounds only) glints the last foe that hurt you, anywhere within 48 blocks.
pages.title: Fighters: Shardback and Rift Hound

text: A **sitting** Storm Moth leaves an invisible **Spirit Click** of redstone **15** once a second, for 2 ticks. Click-true holds it 2 ticks more. It is not a drum: Drumhearts, braziers and keystones ignore it, but song plates and redstone hear it.

A **following** Cinder Imp refunds **4 Pulse** each time you play a Drumheart by hand within **8 blocks**. Redstone beats get nothing, and only one imp pays per beat. Tempo (two copies) refunds 2 more, **6** in all.
pages.title: Storm Moth and Cinder Imp

steps.caption: Set a redstone lamp where your moth will sit, and sneak-use the moth to make it wait beside it.
Once a second an invisible Spirit Click appears where the moth hovers.
The lamp beside it flickers on with every click: a free one-second clock.
A Drumheart on the other side hears nothing, because drums ignore the click.

text: A following Mourning Bell within **8 blocks** clears poison, weakness, hunger, mining fatigue, blindness and nausea from you. Still (two copies) also clears slowness. It never lifts Wither.
A following Echo Weaver picks up drops within **4 blocks** into a **five-slot** pouch and tosses them to you. Gather (two copies) reaches **8**. Sneak-use it empty-handed to empty the pouch yourself.
pages.title: Mourning Bell and Echo Weaver
